span.p:
All 5 bits set → "Probably in cache" → Query cache index
Index lookup: 2 ms (latency paid)
Result: CACHE HIT (or false positive → miss)

span.p:
Performance:
Bloom filter check: 1 microsecond
False positive rate: 0.1% (with M=1M, N=10K, k=7)
Cache miss queries eliminated: 50-80%
